目が合った瞬間、自分が「見られる人」に変わる

You are casually looking at someone across the train. Then they look back. Suddenly you become aware of your own face and posture. サルトルのthe Lookを入口に、the other is not merely an object in my field; another person can see me, turning me into something that appears in another world.
